Professional Summary 
 
Seasoned Project Manager and Certified Scrum Master (6.5 years) with 14+ years of experience driving 
large-scale banking, lending, and regulatory compliance programs across global financial institutions. 
Proven expertise in managing end-to-end project delivery — from scope definition and sprint execution to go-
live readiness, release governance, and hypercare support, with strong stakeholder communication.  
 
Adept at leading Agile–Waterfall hybrid delivery models, integrating Project Tracking Systems (PTS) for 
milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and audit readiness. Skilled in managing cross-functional, onshore–
offshore teams and coordinating with PMOs, vendors, and business stakeholders for seamless delivery.  
 
Experienced in digital transformation initiatives focused on mobile banking, digital onboarding, and 
customer journey modernization, leveraging API-led integration, automation, and data governance 
frameworks to enhance customer experience and regulatory compliance. Strong exposure to service 
transition, including BAU handover, documentation, and end-user training to ensure smooth adoption. 
 
Skill & Core Competencies: 
Agile & Project Management: 
• Certified Scrum Master (CSM) & DASSM-certified Project Manager with proven expertise in 
end-to-end project delivery for banking, lending, and compliance programs. 
• Skilled in Agile–Waterfall hybrid delivery models ensuring on-time, quality-driven results 
across global teams. 
• Led end to end delivery of Digital customer Journey Transformation programs for loan 
origination and drove agile transformation by implementing Scrum and kanban frameworks 
enabling faster release cycles 25-30 % improvement in time to market 
• Strong in release governance, with hands-on expertise in all Scrum ceremonies including 
Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement. 
• Skilled in managing enterprise-level project tracking through PTS (Project Tracking System) for 
governance, milestone tracking, and delivery reporting. 
• Proven expertise in end-to-end project lifecycle management from initiation and planning to 
execution, monitoring, and closure. 
• Managed go-live readiness activities including release planning, cutover checklist, 
environment readiness, and stakeholder sign-offs. 
• Led hypercare support (post go-live) by tracking production issues, prioritizing fixes, and 
coordinating with development, testing, and business teams. 
• Owned handover from project delivery to Business-as-Usual (Service Management) including 
documentation, knowledge transfer, and support process alignment.  
• Conducted training and walkthrough sessions for business users and operations teams to 
ensure smooth adoption. 
• Experienced in regulatory, compliance, and system integration projects under tight delivery 
timelines with cross-regional stakeholder coordination. 
• Strong ability to create and maintain project artifacts (charters, PTS dashboards, status reports, 
RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) logs, and CMP trackers) ensuring 
transparency and audit readiness. 
• Set up governance frameworks with PMO for project status reporting, escalation management, 
and decision tracking. 
• Adept at maintaining audit-ready documentation and governance artifacts, ensuring 
transparency and regulatory compliance. 
• Managed end-to-end Change Request lifecycle, including impact analysis, documentation, 
approval workflows, and implementation under Citi’s PMO governance.  
• Worked with technical teams to estimate effort; define scope, timeline, and resource allocation 
• Adept at maintaining audit-ready documentation and governance artifacts, ensuring transparency 
and regulatory compliance. 
• Worked as JIRA Administrator for multiple Citi projects, configuring workflows, issue types, and 
user access to support Agile delivery. 
Banking & Lending Domain Expertise: 
• Over 11.5 years of BFSI experience, delivering end-to-end banking, lending, and regulatory 
compliance programs for global institutions including Citibank. 
• Successfully led Citi projects such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P) modernization, FINRA compliance 
automation, and KSA RHQ entity onboarding, ensuring governance, audit readiness, and 
regulatory alignment across multiple regions. 
• Expertise in Loan Origination (LOS) and Loan Management Systems (LMS) — covering KYC, 
document verification, underwriting, sanctioning, disbursement, EMI scheduling, repayment, 
foreclosure, and NPA workflows. 
• Hands-on experience in digital lending products such as Loan Against Property (LAP), SME 
Loans, Business Loans, Consumer Durable Loans, and Emerging Enterprise Group (EEG) 
portfolios. 
• Strong knowledge of core banking systems — Finacle, TCS BANCS, Pennant, FINNONE 
Neo, and Welcom Financier — managing integrations, product enhancements, and module 
testing. 
• Proficient in payments & transaction processing (NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, SWIFT, NACH, BACS, 
ARUDD, ADDACS) and system automation for digital operations. 
• Deep understanding of regulatory & compliance frameworks — FINRA, CKYC, CIBIL/CRIF — 
ensuring transparency, data governance, and risk mitigation. 
• Adept at bridging functional, technical, and compliance delivery in complex financial 
ecosystems, enabling digital transformation under strict PMO and governance controls.

Technical & Functional Skills:

• Hands-on experience in PTS, JIRA, Confluence, Zephyr, MS Project, and ServiceNow for 
project tracking, reporting, and documentation. 
• Proficient in coordinating system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT) 
across onshore–offshore teams. 
• Adept at bridging functional and technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment between business 
needs, technology delivery, and compliance frameworks. 
• Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills ensuring audit readiness and 
traceability of all project deliverables. 
 
Professional Experience 
Virtusa Pvt Ltd – Pune | Client: Citibank (Global BFSI Projects) 
Feb 2022 – Till Date 
Project Portfolio: 
Delivered three major Citi programs focused on regulatory compliance, cross -border governance, and 
financial system enablement — including KSA RHQ Entity Enablement, Procure-to-Pay (P2P) 
Modernization, and FINRA Compliance Automation ensuring governance, audit readiness, and regulatory 
alignment across multiple regions (KSA, China, Asia). 
➢ KSA RHQ Entity Onboarding – Set up new legal entity and regulatory framework for Citi’s KSA 
operations under MISA & CBAT compliance. 
The KSA RHQ Entity Enablement Project was initiated under a Saudi regulatory directive requiring 
Citibank to establish a Regional Headquarters legal entity and secure a MISA license. The initiative 
complied with CBAT (Cross-Border Approval & Transparency) processes and involved enabling and 
validating critical financial systems — APS, FFS, PERL, GENESIS, P2P, and eRECON — ensuring 
seamless integration, data integrity, and operational independence of the new entity.  
➢ FINRA Compliance Automation - Automated onboarding and review process for non-employee 
compliance validation. 
The FINRA Compliance Automation Project focused on automating compliance governance and 
onboarding processes for eligible non-employees across the Asia region. The project focused on 
implementing technology-driven solutions to automate the onboarding and compliance review 
process. 
➢ Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization – Modernized procurement and financial workflow for Citi 
China entities. 
The Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Modernization Project was executed as part of Citi’s global P2P program 
to expand procurement and finance operations in China. It involved the setup of two new  legal 
entities, Citi Securities and Citi Futures Company, regulatory approvals, and system integration 
across Fullsuite, PEARL, and S2, including implementation of GL and FA modules. The project  
adopted a dual-cycle testing strategy — pre– and post–regulatory approval — to ensure compliance, 
audit readiness, and localization of financial operations.

• Promoted cross-functional collaboration, accountability, and sprint goal ownership across 
distributed Agile teams.
